 Order

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question proceedings in Crime No.184/2022 registered for offences punishable under Section 498A, 494, 526 r/w Section 34 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. During the pendency of this petition, it transpires that the parties to the lis have settled the issue before the Family Court in M.C.No.3499/2020, which has resulted in dissolution of marriage.

The memorandum of compromise entered therein at paragraph Nos. 4 and 5, reads as follows:
"4. The petitioner has agreed to pay a sum of Rs.6,00,000/- (Rupees Six Lakhs Only)
to the respondent towards all her claims of maintenance/permanent alimony as full and final settlement.

Out of the agreed amount a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs Only) will be paid to the respondent by way of two Demand Drafts bearing No.268494 dated 20.03.2023 drawn on Kotak Mahindra Bank, M.G.Road, Bengaluru and before this Hon'ble Court at the time of reporting this settlement.

The balance amount of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) will be paid to the respondent by way of Demand Draft bearing No.268495 dated 20.03.2023 drawn on Kotak Mahindra Bank, M.G.Road, Bengaluru and the same will be handed over to the respondent before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka, Bengaluru in Crl.P.No.12152/2022.
5.
The respondent has agreed to cooperate in closing/quashing the proceedings in Crime No.184/2022 pending before ACMM-V, Bengaluru.

The petitioner has filed Crl.P.No.12152/2022 before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka, Bengaluru for quashing/closing of the said Crime No.184/2022."
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that during the pending of the proceedings before the concerned Court, Rs.5 lakhs had been paid.
Learned counsel for respondent No.2 acknowledges the said receipt.
The petitioner hands over a Demand Draft of Rs.1 lakh today, which is in full and final settlement of dues in terms of the compromise.
4. In light of the settlement arrived at between the parties as afore-quoted, I deem it appropriate to terminate the proceedings pending against the petitioners in the subject petition.

5. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER i. Criminal Petition stands disposed.
